# Davit Febuan

> Operations leader in Jakarta, Indonesia. E-Channel Services Head at Bank Mega, leading strategy for EDC, QRIS, payment gateway and ATM services. 15+ years across banking, digital and supply chain operations.

## Profile
- [English profile](https://davitfebuan.com/): story, career, expertise, results and contact

## Career
- 2024 – present: E-Channel Services Head, Bank Mega. Strategy for EDC, QRIS, payment gateway and ATM services across the bank's e-channel network.
- 2020 – 2024: Head of Operations, CT Corp Digital. End-to-end digital product development, from concept to launch.
- 2019 – 2020: Distribution Manager, Bhinneka.com. National distribution across B2G, B2B and e-commerce; KPI systems in Power BI.
- 2016 – 2019: Logistics Manager, PT Graha Sumber Prima Elektronik. Manufacturing operations and a $3M+ annual logistics budget; $100K first-year savings.

## Selected results
- 800 EDC devices deployed in year one
- $100K+ logistics cost savings in year one
- 99% on-time delivery rate
- 1% inventory deviation from schedule
- 5%+ sustained annual cost reduction

## Credentials
- Six Sigma Black Belt (Coursera, 2024)
- ISO 9001:2008 & ISO 45001:2018 (Sintegral, 2012)
- Bachelor's degree, Bina Nusantara University (2002–2006)
